subject.title: [Feature]: Support to edit system prompt template

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class user-editable override contract for OpenClaw-owned prompt sections such as Safety, Tool Call Style, OpenClaw Control, and Self-Update?
rationale: The request changes model-facing safety guidance and prompt precedence, and current code only exposes narrower provider, hook, and bootstrap surfaces, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
options.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, and prompt regression tests.

options.title: Keep Existing Surfaces
options.body: Reject new core section overrides and document provider overlays, bootstrap files, and prompt hooks as the supported customization paths.

options.title: Split Narrower Work
options.body: Let identity-line or config-rule issues proceed independently while keeping broad Safety/template editing unresolved.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
recommendation.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, and prompt regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest current history on provider-owned prompt contributions and the OpenClaw-owned prompt boundary this decision would change.
